note: FICTIONAL board meeting for the minutes evaluation (S2.6, D-042). Tuning set. Planted items must appear in the minutes; nothing may be invented.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Good morning. Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.

turns.speaker: Anders Holm
turns.text: I declare an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Thank you, Anders. You will not take part in item four.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: Harrowgate has sent its redline of the Master Services Agreement. The fee rises to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: They also offer a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.

turns.speaker: Sofia Berg
turns.text: I am comfortable with the cap but the fee increase is steep for a two year term.

turns.speaker: Erik Nyström
turns.text: Could we ask for a three year term at the current fee instead?

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: We can ask, but they have not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Then the board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: All in favour? That is carried unanimously.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: I will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.

turns.speaker: Sofia Berg
turns.text: Whether we accept the fee increase at all is still open; we should come back to it once we see their answer.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Item three. The nominations committee recommends Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer from the first of June.

turns.speaker: Erik Nyström
turns.text: I have worked with Maria before and I support the appointment.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: The board resolves to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from the first of June twenty twenty six.

turns.speaker: Sofia Berg
turns.text: I will prepare her service agreement for signature by the end of May.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Item four, Project Lantern. Anders has left the room for this item.

turns.speaker: Erik Nyström
turns.text: The Northbridge team needs a budget of two point four million kronor for twenty twenty six.

turns.speaker: Sofia Berg
turns.text: That seems reasonable given the scope we saw last quarter.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: The board approves a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern. Three votes to none.

turns.speaker: Erik Nyström
turns.text: We still have not agreed who owns the data the project produces. That needs legal advice.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Finally, the dividend. Given the investment programme, I propose no interim dividend this year.

turns.speaker: Sofia Berg
turns.text: Agreed. Shareholders will want to know when we will revisit it.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: The board resolves not to propose an interim dividend. We will revisit it at the September meeting.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: I will draft a short note to shareholders explaining the decision before the end of June.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Thank you all. The meeting is closed.
